answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-work history: an identity must earn its weight first. A newcomer starts at zero weight and takes small paid jobs, each output checked by two verifiers and logged publicly. After 12 verified jobs across 45 days, its reputation ripens from umber to a clear opal shine and it gains full voting rights. One failed check wipes the whole history and bans the key. Forging 10,000 identities means paying for 120,000 fake jobs at $3 each — $360,000 plus 45 days of waiting. Like a reef built coral by coral, real history cannot be faked overnight.
